digest.component_or_area: contributor documentation — git workflow and close discipline
propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge and before closing the ticket via rebar transition close.
The rebar close completion precheck (_referencing_commit_exists) verifies reachability of the merged rebar-ticket: commit from HEAD, and fails if the worktree is not fast-forwarded to the merge.

Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md lacks guidance on post-merge worktree fast-forward discipline, causing operators to incorrectly fast-forward the shared main checkout and clobber uncommitted WIP.

The fix is documentation-only: add post-merge fast-forward guidance to AGENTS.md (close-discipline bullet) and CONTRIBUTING.md (new §2f), with explicit warning never to touch the shared main checkout.

All acceptance criteria verified: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md contain required strings (grep hits on merge --ff-only and shared main checkout), zero code changes outside Markdown, linting passes, and the change merged via Gerrit with attestation of worktree-only close.
